question: What does Article 243C deal with?

options.text: Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of 6 years
Protection of life and personal liberty
Name and territory of the union

solution:
The correct answer is __**Composition of the panchayats**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 243C** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **composition of Panchayats**.
 
• It provides the framework for the **structure and composition** of Panchayats at different levels, including the number of members and their qualifications.
 
• The article also outlines the **manner of election** of the members and the chairpersons of Panchayats.
 
• This article is a part of the **73rd Amendment Act** which was enacted to strengthen the Panchayati Raj system in India.
 
• The **objective** of this provision is to ensure democratic decentralization and local self-governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **73rd Amendment Act** of 1992 added Part IX to the Constitution, which is titled "The Panchayats".
 
• This part contains **Articles 243 to 243O**, covering various provisions related to Panchayats.
 
• The amendment also introduced the **Eleventh Schedule** to the Constitution, which lists 29 subjects over which Panchayats have administrative control.
 
• The aim of these provisions is to **empower rural local governments** and ensure greater participation of the people in the decision-making process at the grassroots level.
 
• The **Panchayati Raj system** is a three-tier system consisting of the Gram Panchayat at the village level, the Panchayat Samiti at the block level, and the Zila Parishad at the district level.
 
• The system is intended to **promote self-governance** and bring about social and economic development in rural areas.
